title: Adjunctions of the open-closed recollement
statement:
For complementary open and closed immersions $j:U\hookrightarrow X$,
$i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ as in the open-closed recollement, one has
$j_!\dashv j^*$ and $i^*\dashv Ri_*$ on the ambient ordinary derived
categories with finite constant coefficients. The open unit and the closed
counit are isomorphisms
$$
 \operatorname{id}\xrightarrow{\sim}j^*j_!,\qquad
 i^*Ri_*\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{id}.
$$
The operations are those of extension by zero, derived direct image, and
derived pullback, tensor and hom.

proof.text: For fixed module coefficients, the existing canonical open sheaf adjunction has invertible unit, by full faithfulness of extension by zero. Apply CategoryTheory.Adjunction.isIso_mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_unit to this exact adjunction. By the definition of ProEtale.derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction, this is precisely the required pro-etale derived unit. The ordinary-etale version is already provided by Etale.isIso_derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction_unit. These statements apply on the entire unbounded derived category.

proof.text: Closed pro-etale direct image is full and faithful by lem-exc-proetale-closed-fully-faithful. Its exact left adjoint is the specified inverse image, so Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes makes closed direct image preserve K-injective complexes. The generic full_rightDerivedFunctor and faithful_rightDerivedFunctor instances then make its total right derived functor full and faithful. Apply Adjunction.counit_isIso_of_R_fully_faithful to the exact canonical derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction appearing in the statement. This proves invertibility of that adjunction's actual counit without changing adjunctions or using exactness of underived closed direct image.

Thus its canonical mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction has invertible counit. Combine this with the existing ordinary-etale open unit by conjunction introduction. lean.note: Lean-only interface repair for this ordinary-etale arbitrary-finite-ring consumer. The current recorded WeilConjectures.openClosedRecollement_adjunctions in Sheaf.Paper.OpenClosedRecollementAdjunctions was read after its concurrent landing: it specializes to Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1), requires a prime l and a finite-dimensional p-adic field E with residue-field invertibility assumptions, and uses pro-etale ring-sheaf modules. It cannot be instantiated for the arbitrary finite commutative A of this item (including mixed-characteristic product rings). This module supplies the ordinary-etale fixed-scalar helper needed by the item, together with the pro-etale fixed-scalar open-unit and closed-counit statement required by the dependency generic finite-constant-coefficient assertion. Both use existing canonical adjunctions; no additional coefficient or residue-characteristic hypothesis is imposed. The earlier sandbox record had only the ordinary-etale helper, which is why the pro-etale clause was supplied in the prior reading.
